svg.text: C MAJOR SCALE — THREE HAND POSITIONS × CAGED

Row 1: three 1-octave boxes (hand below · on · above the root, all at A-string fret 3). Rows 2-6: the same boxes transposed to each CAGED grip — solid C·E·G, ghost D·F·A·B. Open strings shown as ○ at fret 0.
